notes.title: Early Access 7 - New players and Press Conferences
notes.content:
Welcome back TIEBREAK fans. 

As we fast approach the official 22 August 2024 launch, this will be our final Early Access Update - what a great journey it has been!

Community response to TIEBREAK Early Access 6 has been astounding and we’re certainly thrilled to see the community continue to grow with each Early Access release. Hearing discussion about the improvements made across several areas of the game has been fantastic and given the development team a great boost.

[previewyoutube=L_xwqmS6Xw8;full][/previewyoutube]
TIEBREAK has come a long way since Early Access launched in January, and we cannot overstate how essential the community feedback has been. The support, insight, and honesty through this feedback has been invaluable for the development team, as they continue to polish and refine gameplay. 

Honing crucial elements pointed out by the community, including player movement, animation, and the overall gameplay experience, continue to be our highest priority. That said, while this will be our final Early Access update, the feedback we receive on this release will be most important.

The team will be working tirelessly to address key areas of community feedback on this update, right up until the full release date, after which we will welcome TIEBREAK console players, taking in their feedback and suggestions for post release updates.

Early Access 7 includes Press conferences in Career Mode, eight additional ATP/WTA Players and further gameplay improvements.

Serve update

We have honed our serving system by introducing 2 Serve mechanics and have added a new UI that compliments these new designs.

Advanced Serve

Advanced Serve is a high-risk high- reward system. Executing a perfect serve will greatly reward the user by having pinpoint precision and Maximum Serve Speed. Failing to do so will result in a fault and/or speed reduction and accuracy. Hold the A-button to execute an Advanced serve.

 Early - Ball will collide with the net
 Achieving a good early serve (green) will have a slight speed reduction and lose some of their precision and accuracy.
 Perfect Serve will have a pinpoint precision landing in the corners with Maximum Serve Speed.
 A late-timed serve will push the ball long/wide, fault.
Safe Serve

A Safe Serve is considered a conservative serve and is not as punishing when executing a ‘Perfect’ timing. A ‘good-late’ timing is added as a safety net that caters to users who miss the ‘Perfect’ timing window. Hold the B-button to execute a Safe serve.

 Perfect Serve will have a pinpoint precision landing in the corners however the Serve Speed is reduced.
 The ‘Good-Late’ timing window will ensure the ball lands in the serve box with a slight reduction in speed and accuracy.
UI

During the ball toss, a UI element will appear around the ball with 2 circles, an inner and an outer. As the ball moves towards the height of its travel, the smaller inner circle decreases in its radius, while the outer gets smaller at a faster speed, at the point where the two meet, they will be at the same radius as the ball which should be at the height of the ball’s travels. Example shown below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/cd05a7e612ad8d576f86eba3608644dbc893ace1.jpg
The outcome of the serve is displayed by another UI element, where a colour is displayed to tell the user how well they performed.

For the feedback, Orange is early, Green is Good, Red is late/overcooked and Ripple Effect is Perfect.

You can rest assured there is still a lot more to come in TIEBREAK! The full release will include the much-anticipated custom player career mode, an updated roster featuring 120+ players, the addition of doubles, the DJOKOVIC SLAM CHALLENGE mode, and a breadth of additional features and details.

Lastly, and as previously mentioned, for those who have not purchased TIEBREAK Early Access, the final price will be €49.99. Now is the final opportunity to become a part of our Early Access journey at a discount.

Thank you and we’ll see you on the court on 22 August 2024! 

The TIEBREAK Team.

notes.title: Early Access 6 - WTA Finals!
notes.content:
Welcome back TIEBREAK fans for another Steam Early Access update!

The response from the community following Early Access 5 has been fantastic. It certainly was great to receive so much positive feedback regarding how the game is progressing. In particular the feedback relating to the improved character animation and movement, which we know is a key component for many of you, was very well received by the development team. 

[previewyoutube=UnjLmSO-4p4;full][/previewyoutube]

While we love to hear about the positives, we also understand the importance of listening to any feedback regarding shortcomings and rough edges that may remain in the game. As we approach the full release of the game on 22 August, 2024, your continued feedback is more essential than ever, so thank you for helping us make a better game - we love it!

The core focus is to improve the gameplay experience, it remains of paramount importance with each update. In line with player feedback, Early Access 6 hones in on further addressing character animation when performing lunges and responsiveness during volleys. It also sees the expansion of Groundstroke modifiers to include additional shot types. 

Early Access 6 includes WTA Finals added to Tournaments mode, Improved Gameplay & Character Animations, and eight additional WTA/ATP Players;

notes.title: Early Access 5 - Star Player Career!
notes.content:
Welcome back Tiebreak fans for another Steam Early Access update – five is alive!

We have to say we are really pleased with the response and feedback we received for TIEBREAK Early Access 4, it was great to see the positive feedback regarding the progress made in several areas of the game. 

[previewyoutube=J-TOjc5AJpk;full][/previewyoutube]
While we love the positive feedback, we also note and address the negative feedback as it is just as important to making a better game, and we know that the majority of you were not happy with the addition of the adrenaline system. After public discussion and consultation on the TIEBREAK forums and Steam, we have decided to remove it from the game for this Early Access 5. It is our hope with this update that you will see that we have continued taking on and working with your feedback to push the game to its limits. You rest assured that we will continue to work on and improve with each update as we approach final release.

Early Access 5 heralds the introduction of Star Player Career (One Season, for feedback) and a Movement and Groundstroke revamp, plus eight additional ATP / WTA players;

While we have your attention here, we’d like to shout out to the many new fans that have joined us on the forums to give feedback, we’re so pleased to have you all onboard - please keep that feedback coming!

The final release of TIEBREAK (on August 22nd, 2024) will include the ability to play a career with custom players, in addition to Star Player Career Mode. In the meantime, TIEBREAK Early Access releases will introduce even more new players, WTA finals, press conferences for Star Player Career Mode and gameplay improvements (of course!).

We would like to remind those that have not purchased TIEBREAK Early Access that the final price will be €49.99, and in line with that, there will be a price increase to €39.99 on 10 June 2024.

Lastly, there has been a lot of feedback on the smaller details such as line judges, ball kids, and a challenge system, these will certainly be included in future updates, but for now our focus is the core gameplay and implementing change based on the TIEBREAK experience you have shared with us.

Thank you! We’ll see you on the court!

notes.content:
Hello again Tennis and TIEBREAK fans!

 Adrenaline Skills
 Stamina
 Nitto Finals
 Online Scheduled Tournaments[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/8a6aa1b9644a7881c63e49f123893cd9d7691df6.png
Detailed Descriptions:

1 - Additional Players: 

TIEBREAK Early Access 4 sees the addition of three new ATP and three new WTA players. 

 Carlos Alcaraz 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/6b68113d99e801f10fb6279431a3eefbd142f679.jpg
 Grigor Dimitrov

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/1c83c2849b7f94ab4a590eefdf492ed66acde583.jpg
 Francis Tiafoe

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/5f3e6f17cf661e63f206e6ef2f32c077c0c601b9.jpg
 Emma Raducanu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/2f7b50d0ee1243f28d8ea16172dfdf82cdcbccb8.jpg
 Karolina Pliskova

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/e53c64e2bbbf41fce45e5ee70938d116193eab4f.jpg
 Madison Keys

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/0fca855a800ebee56cb83f63e4ee41cebe9b3f87.jpg
2 - Adrenaline Skills:
TIEBREAK Early Access 4 sees the addition of Adrenaline Skills, a completely new gameplay feature. Adrenaline Skills allow you to modify your strokes and movement during matches. Adrenaline accumulates during matches, Applying power to a shot, winning contested points such as clutch points, long rallies, and breakpoints will all add to the Adrenaline Bar. Used for both offensive or defensive purposes, Adrenaline allows for greater, deeper strategy during points, to help you recover or play that winner at just the right time.

To execute Adrenaline Skills, hold down RB, and press one of the stroke buttons (Y, X, A). The amount of adrenaline required and consumed whenever executing shots is displayed on corresponding icons.

Note: This feature will be expanded to allow further customisation in TIEBREAK Early Access 5.

3 - Stamina:
TIEBREAK Early Access 4 implements a stamina bar to display your fatigue levels throughout a match. Your Stamina will be directly affected by the amount of power applied to your strokes, on-court movement, and lunges.

Stamina can be regained while stationary during points, resting after games and at the end of each set.  You will notice that as the Stamina bar is depleted your movement around the court will be impacted.

4 - Nitto Finals:
Experience the end-of-Year ATP Tournament, the Nitto Finals. Take on the current best in the world in round-robin and knockout tournaments to determine who is truly the champion! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/ec8a46a69707151a6c81a6f4b5e0d7d27e858b86.png
5 - Online Scheduled Tournaments:
TIEBREAK Early Access 4 sees the addition of all remaining ATP/WTA 1000 tournaments to online. Fight to the top of the leaderboard for each tournament, add ranking points to your overall season tally and make World Number 1!

Note: Each scheduled tournament will last two days for those who want to take their online gameplay to the next level.

Closing Remarks:

For those who have already taken part in TIEBREAK Early Access, we hope you find that this update reflects the direction you have given. We do still have so much more planned for future updates, and we would love for you to continue with us on this journey, and while a lot has been achieved, we know there is still a road ahead as we focus on animation and gameplay.

Your continued support and feedback ensure we are moving in the right direction and improving the game with each of the updates.

Thank you! We’ll see you on the court!
The Tiebreak Team

notes.title: Early Access 3 - Venue Creator and Online Tournaments
notes.content:
Dear Tennis and Tiebreak fans, happy Easter!

We again thank everyone that has participated in our Tiebreak Early Access, we are thrilled with how the game is shaping up and this is in no small part due to the great feedback we have received from you. Please keep it coming!

For those new to the process, the Tiebreak designers have been engaging with community members and taking player feedback on board daily. Each piece of feedback being invaluable to the development team in refining elements of the game and ensuring Tiebreak is a game that excites every Tennis fan. Over the coming months you will see us continue to iterate on gameplay, fluidity of animations, physics, player likenesses, and some new additions to the game that we haven’t shown off just yet. We’re so excited to tell you about what’s to come!

[previewyoutube=UzGe-eeQxyQ;full][/previewyoutube]
This brings us to today, where we’d like to announce what you’ll get to see in Tiebreak's next phase of Early Access, which we call Early Access 3 (EA3).

 8 Additional Licensed Players
 Venue Creator (Crowd to be added later)
 Online Tournaments
 Overall Gameplay & Physics Improvements
Detailed Descriptions:

Additional Players:
Tiebreak Early Access 3 adds four new ATP & four new WTA players. 

●	Karen Khachanov
●	Borna Coric
●	Yoshihito Nishioka
●	Felix Auger-Aliassime
●	Anett Kontaveit
●	Daria Kasatkina
●	Daria Saville
●	Iga Swiatek

Venue Creator:
You can now create your own customised venues with the addition of the Venue Creator, and also share them with others online!

Design, style, and craft your own Tennis Venue with the Venue Creator. You choose the location, surrounding scenery, stadiums, court logos, and more using the Venue Creator tools – you can now design your dream venue, or recreate beloved all-time favorites. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/c7cec7385c728d631f4404827714f7138a1c8c53.png
The Venue Creator allows you to mix and match your venue layout. Design centre court, show courts, outer courts and place up to seven of them around your venue. With a variety of stadiums, grandstands, buildings, and environmental features, you are set to make your mark on the tour.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/bf37fd10fcb9e4e2ea2b09f134ac16983417aae0.png
Online Tournaments are a new Tiebreak feature added to EA3, allowing you to participate across a whole season of fully licensed ATP/WTA online events and earn ATP & WTA ranking points in PvP matches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/a72b0fa121c8b19d4fd839dc558757fd4be16a4d.png
Just like on tour, you must perform consistently across the season to climb the ATP/WTA online leaderboards or defend your spot.

●	Fine-tuned Net Scramble
-	Improvements to RT/LT approach to net

-	You must accurately judge the direction of serve (chance of receiving ace increased)

●	Adjustment to Stroke Power Meter UI

Closing Remarks:

This successfully completes the Early Access feature set outlined in the roadmap for February/March. As we now excitedly take a look towards the next phase of Tiebreak Early Access, we want to assure you, that our goals for community feedback remain unchanged. We are hoping that you will continue to play a key role in EA4 and provide us with feedback on what you’d like to see in the future.

The Tiebreak Team

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/9726ef704c53613487d9afbdef8e44aef5d810be.jpg

Dear Tennis and Tiebreak fans, 

We would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone that has participated in the first phase of Tiebreak Early Access. Our key goal when the Early Access began was to ensure that the community was given an opportunity to play a key role in shaping the final version of the game.

The feedback and support from the community has been extraordinary, we love it! We are on the right track, and you are playing a crucial part in ensuring that we deliver the most authentic tennis experience we have released to date. While we have been improving the gameplay, and delivering updates along the way, we have also been working on elements not yet implemented. Today we would like to announce what is coming in this new update of Tiebreak that we call Early Access 2 (EA2).

[previewyoutube=aMIOZN3PNPU;full][/previewyoutube]
Patch overview:
 8 Additional Licensed Players
 Online Custom Matches
 Academy (Player Creator, Logo Creator & Community)
 Overall Gameplay and Physics Improvements
Additional Players:

Tiebreak Early Access 2 adds four new ATP & four new WTA players.
 Caroline Garcia
 Coco Gauff
 Beatriz Haddad Maia
 Benoît Paire
 Casper Ruud
 Ben Shelton
 Amanda Anisimova
 Stan Wawrinka

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/acb1f44497a1bd7db8a7ba056d40565954a60e1f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/d8a80b5e6d114d3d5b8ca0df929d1b645f8b024b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/107b5864e16c30dcf2617007f7b2e78eb9c732ea.png
Online Custom Matches: 

Players can now create custom online matches. 
Choose your Point system, Sets per match, games per set, tie break length, venue, and more. With an array of gameplay options available, you can design matches to suit your preferred play style. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/ceb9d1148c9356dcca038dfbb13d4523ee1676f0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/5b30477653f22be039040892ff1273c43c551fd9.png
Prefer to pick up and play with quick matches? 
Try the Fast 4-point system with one set per match. 

Enjoy the challenge of battling it out in the final set? 
Make tie breaks 10 points or decide the final set by winning two games. Online Custom Matches allow you to take charge of your Tiebreak experience.

Academy (Player Creator, Logo Creator & Community):

Player Creator:
Tell your own story. Customize your player's identity, appearance, clothing & equipment, play style, physical attributes & skills to create your very own player. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/c51658c99aa0538a3b56fa1806c8b4bc8b75f79b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/5de5006d0c90b1263d9687ef50cd0dae753604fc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/8fced1450b0c0e2b6a6964990ab525e3f50e581a.png
Tiebreak’s Player Creator offers an extensive list of features that allows you to customise your appearance, from your body shape and facial structure, all the way through to freckle & mole placement. 

Choose how you play with Play Styles. You can decide what kind of player you want to be. Choose your dominant hand, style of backhand, Service, and Receiving style. Customise your net aggression and choose which surface and game style you are best suited to. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832303/2b50beecc10760b861040762c324d5368e3c80a2.png
Balance your strengths and weaknesses with Attributes and Skills. Want to be dominant with an aggressive forehand volley? Want opponents to fear your quick reactions and baseline speed? You can take full advantage of the Attributes and Skills sliders to create a fleshed-out and intricate playstyle that suits every preferred style of gameplay. 

Logo Creator:
Use a variety of in game tools to design and generate your own custom logo. Logo Creator allows you to import SVG images and use a breadth of design tools to create an endless amount of logos that can be applied to player clothing and equipment. 

Academy: 
Download and Share custom-created players through the academy. EA2 will see the Academy added to the game, allowing you to upload and share players you have created with the community. The Academy will also allow you to download players created and uploaded by other members of the community into your own roster. 

Overall Gameplay and Physics Improvements: 

▶ Improved player movement
● Sprinting and strafing feels more grounded and weighted
● Transitioning between animation is much smoother.
● Tuned acceleration and deceleration of movement.
● Hold LT and RT + Joystick Forward will make the player scramble to the net 

▶ Improved Ball Physics
● Serves speed feels more realistic.

▶ Superseded Serve Type UI

▶ Improved ToolTips

▶ Pressing ‘B’ to skip Cutscene, which subsequently rectifies user’s accidentally doing a fault from a serve.

▶ New Camera functionality- camera will slightly zoom out to improve court view when the ball goes off screen (player’s peripheral vision). This will help users when they are receiving wider shots.  

The Tiebreak Team
